stories.title: Social media is full of weird video game mashups. Where are they all coming from?
summary: Your feed, like mine, will have been full of clips of streamers playing bizarre mashups of popular video games.
Basically, as of a few weeks ago, Anthropic’s Claude has become extremely good at decompiling video game code.

Games are written by humans in readable code and then compiled into binary 1s and 0s that the PC or console running it can read; decompiling is the reversal of that process, revealing a game’s source code, which humans can then edit and mess around with for fun.
